description.zh: 把 Harness 调成干净的白纸界面：纯白画布、暖调中性文字、统一的控件形状与间距、有信息量的动效；插件关闭后精确回到出厂外观。
description.en: Turns Harness into a clean paper-like surface: white canvas, warm neutral text, unified control shapes and spacing, motion that carries information. Disabling it restores the shipped interface exactly.
